messages:
elaine: Heads-up — intermittent TLS handshakes failing for `search-api` when routed through eu-west-1 proxies. Started ~04:10UTC after yesterday's RBAC tidy. Logs show KMS decrypt errors and certificate fetch timeouts. Anyone seeing this?
igor: Yep, I hit the same alert. Example log: `kms.Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException`. Happens during cert rewrap in eu-west-1 only. us-east-1 ok. Created ticket INFRA-4523.
sam: That was me — I removed an old role binding from `cert-rotator` yesterday. I thought it was unused. If that's the cause I can revert, but want to avoid breaking IAM more.
elaine: Failure rate ~0.8% normally, spikes to ~5% during short bursts. Auto-failover routed to us-east and APAC, so customer impact is partial but visible. Traces show TLS handshake stalls ~200–400ms then resets.
security_oncall: Priority-high. If KMS denies are source, two quick options: 1) restore previous binding for eu-west-1, or 2) grant `kms:Decrypt` narrowly for the `cert-rotator` principal and re-run rewrap. Prefer least privilege change (2).
igor: Agreed. Quick repro command I used: ```bash
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.bin --region eu-west-1 --key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:1234567890:key/abcd-ef01
```
igor: Response was `AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::... is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource ...`
sam: I can push an IAM patch. Proposed policy snippet: ```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": ["arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:1234567890:key/ingress-tls-*"],
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalTag/role": "cert-rotator"}}
}
```
elaine: Add short audit scope: after patch, search CloudTrail for `eventName=Decrypt` AND `awsRegion=eu-west-1` to confirm only cert-rotator used it. Also grep for `tls_handshake_error` across proxies in that window.
cert-rotator: Automated rotation job attempted at 04:12UTC. Result: `FAILURE: KMS decrypt error (AccessDenied)` for eu-west-1. us-east-1 succeeded.
deploy-bot: Canary rollouts saw fallback to RSA ciphers in some proxies due to ALPN mismatch; not content-breaking but increases latency ~30ms.
security_oncall: Also check TLS configs — we noticed one proxy in eu-west had `TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256` but disabled `TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256` for TLS1.3 by mistake during last cipher hardening PR. Could be related to handshake algorithm negotiation hitting code path that requires cert rewrap.
igor: Good catch. Quick triage: 1) grant kms:Decrypt as scoped above, 2) re-run cert-rotator for eu-west, 3) temporarily allow TLS1.3 ciphers back if rotation doesn't fix.
sam: I'll open PR to add policy and a reversible RBAC change; pinging infra-iam for review.
elaine: I'll run audit queries and monitor SLOs, and coordinate a minor canary to ensure no regressions. If we see other regions show similar pattern, we'll escalate to cross-region ops.
security_oncall: Also track as vuln triage item: double-check OpenSSL/boringssl versions on proxies to ensure we aren't hitting a known handshake bug (no CVE currently, but surface area to confirm).
sam: PR in flight: https://git.internal/redwood/iam/pulls/1389 — adding reviewer @igor. Will keep it short-lived and document revert steps.
igor: After policy patch, I will trigger `cert-rotator --region eu-west-1 --force-rewrap` and post results.
cert-rotator: Rewrap queued once IAM change is detected.
elaine: Thanks — keeping this thread for audit trail. If anyone sees spike after change, ping #oncall immediately and escalate to pager. :rotating_light:
security_oncall: Noted. Assigning owners: Sam -> IAM PR, Igor -> rewrap & smoke tests, Elaine -> monitoring + postmortem writeup.
elaine: I'll draft a short postmortem template with timeline, root cause (RBAC drift -> KMS deny -> cert rewrap failure -> partial TLS fallback), mitigation, and follow-ups (tighten RBAC review process, add CI check for cross-region role bindings, add audit dashboard).
